message.content:
This editorial illustration features a large, gold-toned coin with a stylized "B" symbol, resembling a Bitcoin, tilted and floating over a light blue surface covered in various white and blue speech bubble shapes. A man in a dark grey suit balances precariously on the top edge of the coin. Above him, another man in a black suit with a light blue tie and a woman in a brown blazer and dark pants appear to be falling through the air. The man is positioned horizontally, while the woman is angled downward with her hands outstretched.

The background is a solid light blue. The top of the image contains the word "TEMPO" in large white capital letters, with "50 Tahun!" in cursive script below it. The text at the top reads "MENGUAK PELECEHAN SEKSUAL DI PESANTREN" and "KONTROVERSI PADUAN SUARA DI MASJID ISTIQLAL." To the right, bold black text states "BAHAYA DEMAM KRIPTO," followed by a paragraph in smaller black font. The bottom right corner displays a barcode, a QR code, the date "24-30 MEI 2021," the price "RP 45.000," and other publication details.
